state.paragraph: As part of its ongoing review of strategic alternatives, at an in-person meeting of the Board on April 5, 2013, the Board discussed the sale of CSC to Pamplona as well as industry-wide merger and acquisition activity and dynamics, and authorized Mac-Gray management to work with BofA Merrill Lynch to explore transactional opportunities that might be available to Mac-Gray, including opportunities with another strategic party, whom we refer to as Party A, in the laundry facilities management industry. The Board also determined to further consider Mac-Gray's strategic alternatives at its meeting scheduled for May 9, 2013.

ledger_rows.Note: Target financial adviser; first seen acting in this sale exploration. Its earlier mandate concerned Mac-Gray's contemplated acquisition of CSC.
Target-initiated approach; Party A said it might consider a business combination.
Mac-Gray outside legal counsel; first seen acting in the relevant review.

adviser.instructions: `paragraph` reports that a financial or legal adviser is retained, engaged, terminated or first shown acting for the target, a committee or a bidder. Is every such event in `paragraph` recorded by some entry in `ledger_rows` (same party, same kind of event, consistent date)?

criteria.true: Each such event has a matching ledger entry, possibly summarised in an entry's Note.
criteria.false: At least one such event in the paragraph has no matching ledger entry.
